namespace: Orchestrate independent background subagents for concurrent execution.
instructions: Use subagent_list to inspect status and historyDir paths. Use write or msg_write to agent addresses, or your children.sock to broadcast to direct active agents without opening custom socket connections. Messaging a stopped agent revives it for a new round.

create.description: Create background subagents for concurrent execution. Returns agent IDs and socket addresses; does not wait for task completion.
create.snippet: Delegate parallel workloads to direct subagents
create.guideline: Write requirements primarily in English. Delegate parallel work while continuing your own tasks, or conclude your turn to wait for completion notifications (do not poll). Use inheritContext: true for branching work or parallel exploration off this session. Keep coupled workflows local, or isolate potential conflicts in git worktrees for you to merge; subagents must not depend on each other.

parameters.context: Background, constraints, and source material shared by every task in this batch.

tasks.description: Independent workloads. Order is preserved in the result, but it does not create execution dependencies.

items.name: Caller-facing label; defaults to none.
items.task: Self-contained assignment: scope, deliverables, and how to verify completion.
items.inheritContext: Inherit this session's conversation and capabilities. Default false: start with clean context.

list.description: Returns a scoped tree of related agents (parent, peers, and direct children; capped at 4 per group, active first). Active direct children are expanded; stopped nodes are folded. Nodes carry latest history paths, and durable roots include historyDir (<jobId>/summary.md for outcomes, transcript.jsonl for logs; inspect via read). Does not wait for completion.
list.snippet: Check background agent progress and history paths

parameters.all: Show every agent without group limits or folding. Default false.
parameters.id: Filter to a specific agent's visible subtree. Returns null if absent.

stop.description: Request cancellation of an agent by id. May return stopping or finalizing while execution or history writes finish; does not wait for shutdown.
stop.snippet: Cancel a background agent's current run

msg_write.description: Send a plain-text message to a managed Agent IPC endpoint: Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe. The host binds the sender and transport framing. Omit from/to, JSON or NDJSON envelopes, and trailing newlines. Cannot write files.
msg_write.snippet: Send plain-text messages to agents through their Socket paths
guidelines: Provide the message body as plain text content; do not add from/to, JSON/NDJSON framing, a trailing newline, or a custom Socket client.

parameters.path: Returned Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe address.
parameters.content: Plain-text message body. The host frames the transport and binds the sender.
